_note: Piper 1 (close arm) for richardshkim/pi05_piper_banana_v2_full (LeRobot pi0.5, 20 demos of 'Put banana into basket.' on someone else's Piper). Same as piper_1.json except: control_hz 30 (the dataset's fps); gripper policy units 0..1 = 0..0.07 m (dataset range 0..1; the 0.07 m stroke is our assumption). Run with --lerobot ... --end-pose-state: the checkpoint's state is 13-D, joints + gripper + end pose. Limits/rates as piper_1.json. Joint limits from the Piper spec sheet (J1 +-150, J2 0..180, J3 -170..0; both arms rest at about J2 -2 deg / J3 +2 deg, just past these limits; the firmware (S-V1.8-3) clamps commands to J2 >= 0 / J3 <= 0, so commanding the rest pose lifts the arm 2 deg (seen 2026-10-06), and SafetyFilter.check_state's 0.05 rad margin accepts the rest pose, J4 +-100, J5 +-70, J6 +-120 deg), gripper stroke 0..0.07 m: VERIFY against your firmware/manual, then set verified=true.  verified=true 2026-10-06: spec limits with J2/J3 matched to firmware clamping; units/sign checked by verify --wiggle and a +-17..30 deg per-joint movement test (all within 0.5 deg).
